commands.name: The Northern Fens
commands.description: Willow country and fen north of Ravenford: the Mill Road, Hollowmere and the Fogmarsh.

commands.name: Ravenford
commands.description: A trading town on the Old Trade Road, walled in grey river-stone.

commands.name: North Gate
commands.description: The town’s northern gate, where wagons bound for the marsh villages are loaded at dawn.

commands.name: The Mill Road
commands.description: A rutted cart road from Ravenford north through willow country to the edge of the Fogmarsh.

commands.name: The Willow Ford
commands.description: The Mill Road crosses the Sedge Brook here between leaning willows; the water runs knee-deep and cold.

commands.name: Hollowmere
commands.description: A village of reed-cutters and eel-fishers on stilts and causeways at the edge of the Fogmarsh. A stone bell tower leans over its green.

commands.name: The Reeve’s Hall
commands.description: A long timber hall under a turf roof, where the reeve keeps the village tallies and its lamp-oil.

commands.name: The Hall’s Cellar
commands.description: A damp cellar of barrels and salt-sacks; something has gnawed up through the floor from below.

commands.name: The Bell Tower
commands.description: A squat stone tower older than the village, its bronze bell silent by day. The rope hangs within anyone’s reach.

commands.name: The Fogmarsh
commands.description: Reed-beds, black pools and drowned alders under a fog that rarely lifts. Lights move there at night.

commands.name: The Drowned Chapel
commands.description: A chapel on a reedy islet, half sunk since the great flood; its doors are barred from the inside.

commands.name: The Sunken Mill
commands.description: An old water-mill whose wheel stands in still water; flat boats are tied up beneath its floor.

commands.name: Flooded Crypt
commands.description: Stone stairs go down into black water and a vaulted crypt where the old saints were laid.

commands.name: Chamber of the Sunken Bell
commands.description: A round chamber below the crypt where a second, older bell hangs over a pool, its clapper green with copper.

commands.name: Agna Brisk
commands.description: A lamp-oil merchant’s widow, brisk as her name, with ink on her fingers and no patience for excuses.

commands.name: Hobb Fenwick
commands.description: Hollowmere’s reeve, a heavy, tired man who counts everything twice and has slept badly since the bell began.

commands.name: Sister Ilse
commands.description: Keeper of the drowned saint’s shrine, now kept in a fisher’s hut; sharp-eyed, devout and afraid of nothing living.

commands.name: Kerra Reed
commands.description: A ferrywoman in a cloak of woven reeds, a boat-hook on her shoulder; she knows every channel of the marsh.

commands.name: Old Matthis
commands.description: Hollowmere’s bell-ringer, white-bearded and half-deaf after fifty years of bells.

commands.name: Hooded Lantern-Bearer
commands.description: A gaunt figure in a grey hood carrying a lantern whose light never flickers.

commands.name: The Reed Cloaks
commands.description: Marsh-folk who move goods along the channels by night, untaxed and unasked.

commands.name: The Ashen Circle
commands.description: Hooded zealots who mark their deeds with a ring of ash.

commands.name: The Hollowmere Bell
commands.description: A bronze bell green with age. Three nights running it rang at midnight with no hand on its rope.

commands.name: Bell Rope
commands.description: A thick hemp rope, frayed and stained green at the knot where it was mended.

commands.name: Churned Mud
commands.description: The bank of the ford is trampled by many small feet and scored where something was dragged.

commands.name: The Drowned Altar
commands.description: A stone altar standing in a hand’s depth of water, its carvings of bells worn smooth.

commands.name: Cracked Floor-Slab
commands.description: A broad slab before the altar, cracked across, with a small bell carved in one corner.

commands.name: Marsh Lights
commands.description: Pale lights that drift over the reed-beds and draw back when approached.

commands.name: The Sunken Bell
commands.description: An ancient bell hung low over black water; when it moves, the water shivers before any sound comes.

commands.name: Wagon of Lamp-Oil and Salt
commands.description: A covered wagon of oil jars packed in straw and sacks of grey salt, with a patient mule in the shafts.

commands.name: Tarred Ledger
commands.description: A ledger in a tarred cover, kept dry in an oilcloth; its last pages are in a hurried hand.
